tours.name: Wildlife & Heritage
tours.blurb: Leopards at Yala, the elephant gathering at Minneriya and three UNESCO sites in one week, ending on the beach at Bentota.
highlights: Jeep safari in Yala, famous for leopards
Walk Horton Plains to World's End
Temple of the Tooth in Kandy
tours.alt: A leopard resting on a branch, looking straight at the camera

tours.name: Buddhist Pilgrimage
tours.blurb: Eight days through the island's sacred cities, from Mihintale where Buddhism first took root to the Temple of the Tooth in Kandy.
highlights: Dambulla cave temple, over 150 Buddha statues
Mihintale, birthplace of Buddhism in Sri Lanka
tours.alt: Novice monks in orange robes walking down ancient stone steps

tours.name: Ramayana Trail
tours.blurb: Seven days along the sites of the Ramayana, from Munneswaram where Rama prayed to the Seetha Amman temple in Nuwara Eliya.
highlights: Ramboda Hanuman temple and Ravana Falls
tours.alt: Daylight through the mouth of Ravana Cave near Ella

tours.name: Ayurveda Wellness Retreat
tours.blurb: Two weeks of Ayurvedic treatment with resident physicians and therapists, daily yoga and every meal included.
highlights: Full board with snacks and beverages
tours.alt: A hand holding fresh purple flowers

tours.name: Honeymoon
route: Planned around the two of you
tours.blurb: Nine nights for two, drawn around you: a private car, half-board hotels and the island's quiet corners.
highlights: Half board hotels, breakfast and dinner
Entrance fees as per the programme
tours.alt: A couple embracing on the beach at sunset

tours.name: Cultural Package
tours.blurb: The two places every first visit needs: the rock fortress at Sigiriya and the Temple of the Tooth in Kandy.
tours.alt: Sigiriya rock rising above the forest at sunset

tours.name: The Full Circuit
tours.blurb: The whole island in ten days: the cultural triangle, tea country by train, a Yala safari and the Galle coast.
highlights: Nuwara Eliya and the train to Ella
tours.alt: The Vatadage at Polonnaruwa with its seated Buddha

tours.name: Best of Sri Lanka
tours.blurb: Kandy, the train ride to Ella, a leopard safari at Yala and Galle Fort. Built for a first visit.
highlights: Add whale watching in Mirissa, November to April
tours.alt: Diyaluma Falls dropping through green hills near Ella

tours.name: Short Stay
tours.blurb: A first taste in four days: Negombo's lagoon, the Temple of the Tooth and a Madu River boat ride from Bentota.
highlights: Bentota beach and the Madu River
tours.alt: The Temple of the Tooth in Kandy under a blue sky
